sloka: अथवा धारयिष्यामि क्रोधमद्य निशामिमाम् ।गृह्यतामुदयस्स्वैरं कामभोगेषु वानर ॥४-११-३३॥।।
transliteration: athavā dhārayiṣyāmi krodhamadya niśāmimām ।gṛhyatāmudayassvairaṁ kāmabhogeṣu vānara ॥4-11-33॥।।

translations.english: 'O monkey I will restrain my anger tonight and give you time for your indulgence in sensual pleasures till morning.
